lyrics.original: 자그만 말 하나에도 기분이 좋아질 수 있게요
lyrics.romanization: Jageuman mal hanaedo gibuni joajil su itgeyo
lyrics.english: Even in a small bite can make me feel better

lyrics.original: 사랑 같은 건 아마 원래 쓰디쓴 걸까요
lyrics.romanization: Sarang gateun geon ama wonrae sseudisseun geolkkayo
lyrics.english: Love is so bitter when it's the first time
I don't like it, what should I do?

lyrics.original: 어른이 되는 것 만큼, 사랑도 힘든 걸요
lyrics.romanization: Eoreuni doeneun geot mankeum, Sarangdo himdeun geolyo
lyrics.english: Love is as hard as being an adult

lyrics.original: 자그만 말 하나에도 기분이 좋아질 수 있게요
lyrics.romanization: Jageuman mal hanaedo gibuni joajil su itgeyo
lyrics.english: Even in a small bite can make me feel better

lyrics.original: 우리 사탕 같은 사랑하며, 사르르 녹아질래요? 어때요?
lyrics.romanization: Uri satang gateun saranghamyeo, Sareureu nogajillaeyo? Eottaeyo?
lyrics.english: We love each other like a candy, Do you want to melt it? How was it?

lyrics.original: 그대 맘을 다 가지고 싶다면 어린 맘인가요
lyrics.romanization: Geudae mameul da gajigo sipdamyeon eorin mamingayo
lyrics.english: If I want to have your whole heart, do I have to be young?

lyrics.original: 상처 뿐인 하루라도 한번은 웃을 수 있게요
lyrics.romanization: Sangcheo ppunin harurado han beoneun useul su itgeyo
lyrics.english: Even it hurts me inside every day, so I can smile once
